title: Optional paid activity
brief: Filter optional activity without removing the parent.
instructions: Return every customer with the number of paid orders in UTC 2024. Keep customers without any qualifying order as zero.
For paid reporting activity, include timestamps at or after 2024-01-01 00:00:00 UTC and exclude timestamps at or after 2025-01-01 00:00:00 UTC.
Return only the declared output columns, in their declared order and exact SQL types. Follow the output ordering contract; NULL ordering is explicit.
starterExplanation: This starter exposes customer_id,customer_name from customers without solving optional paid activity.

hints.text: Filter the optional relation without filtering away preserved parents.
Put the qualifying-order predicate in the left join condition or a prefiltered relation.
Customer 10002 has an order but only a pending order.

dataClaims.sql: SELECT (count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'pending'))::VARCHAR || '/' || count(*)::VARCHAR FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 10002
dataClaims.claim: hints[2]: customer 10002 has exactly one order and it is pending
